تضطهدون (form VIII)
# تَضْطَهِدُونَ (taḍṭahidūna) /tadˤ.tˤa.hi.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# تُضْطَهَدُونَ (tuḍṭahadūna) /tudˤ.tˤa.ha.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
